title: Topocode package boundaries
summary: The root Yarn workspace configuration defines thirteen current packages. Selected arrows show compile-time workspace dependencies declared in package manifests, not runtime calls, deployment, ownership, or a complete import graph.

sections.title: @topo/cli
sections.body: Command-line composition package. Its manifest declares workspace dependencies on diagram-core, enrichment, graph, modules, reports, scanner, schema, site, story, views, and workspace; the map selects its diagram-core relationship.

sections.title: @topo/diagram-core
sections.body: Pinned Archify rendering boundary. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on story.

sections.title: @topo/story
sections.body: Authored story parsing and source-evidence resolution package. Its manifest declares no internal workspace dependency.

sections.title: @topo/eslint-config
sections.body: Shared lint configuration selected by the root tools/eslint-config workspace entry. Its manifest declares no internal workspace dependency.

sections.title: @topo/reports
sections.body: Report normalization package. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on schema.

sections.title: @topo/scanner
sections.body: Repository scanning package. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on schema.

sections.title: @topo/workspace
sections.body: Local workspace and generated-artifact package. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on schema.

sections.title: @topo/enrichment
sections.body: Enrichment document package. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on schema.

sections.title: @topo/schema
sections.body: Shared graph and artifact schema package. Its manifest declares no internal workspace dependency.

sections.title: @topo/graph
sections.body: Graph projection and layout package. Its manifest declares a workspace dependency on schema.

sections.title: @topo/modules
sections.body: Module composition package. Its manifest declares workspace dependencies on graph and schema; the map selects its graph relationship.

sections.title: @topo/views
sections.body: Curated views package. Its manifest declares workspace dependencies on graph and schema; the map selects its graph relationship.

sections.title: @topo/site
sections.body: Browser explorer package. Its manifest declares workspace dependencies on enrichment, graph, modules, schema, and views; the map selects its views relationship.
